hook.name: EulerSwap
hook.description: A custom AMM hook that replaces the Uniswap v4 pricing curve with a bespoke concentrated liquidity curve backed by Euler Finance vaults. On each swap, input tokens are deposited into and output tokens are withdrawn from Euler vaults, with on-chain reserves validated against the custom curve invariant. Standard liquidity positions are blocked; all liquidity flows through Euler vault collateral.
